a-romance-of-billy-goat-hill: Alice Hegan Rice — beloved author of Mrs. Wiggs of the Cabbage Patch — sets this romance on Billy-Goat Hill, where a poor but proud Kentucky family guards its dignity. A young woman's heart and a neighborhood's prejudices collide in a story full of local color. Rice's affection for her characters shines on every page.
wilhelm-tell: Schiller's beloved drama tells of William Tell, the Swiss marksman forced to shoot an apple from his son's head, and the uprising his defiance inspires. Freedom, tyranny, and the Alps themselves fill this stirring play. Performed ever since 1804, it remains the classic drama of liberty.
the-coming-of-bill: Wodehouse's comedy turns on Bill — a baby whose arrival upends the lives, romances, and ambitions of the adults around him. Custody battles and love affairs tangle in the author's inimitable style. A lesser-known Wodehouse, but pure delight for his fans.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-st-g: A 1913 entry on St. Gall, the Swiss abbey of the famous plan and library. Irish Gall's hermitage grew great. George Cyprian Alston details its riches. The most learned house of the Alps. Notker the Stammerer sang his sequences in its choir.
